NOBLE alert category, complete native report productions and typed fields

These are source deductions from retained PE/Ghidra output, not game-screen
observations or translation tests. Addresses below are reference-image RVAs.

Category and rendering boundary
  announcement-popup-native/native-announcement-alert-routing.tsv records all
  356 native announcement values from both configured Windows PE images.
  Reference helper eaa20..eab13 / classic ea9b0..eaaa3 maps exactly these 14
  values to remap entry 8, alert group 7 NOBLE:
    68 NOBLE_ARRIVAL
    79 DIPLOMAT_ARRIVAL
    80 LIAISON_ARRIVAL
    81 TRADE_DIPLOMAT_ARRIVAL
    178 FORT_POSITION_SUCCESSION
    254 LAND_GAINS_STATUS
    255 LAND_ELEVATED_STATUS
    263 MANDATE_ENDS
    266 ELECTION_RESULTS
    273 DEMAND_FORGOTTEN
    274 NEW_DEMAND
    275 NEW_MANDATE
    276 PRICES_ALTERED
    280 GUILD_WAGES_CHANGED
  341 DIPLOMAT_LEFT_UNHAPPY belongs to GENERAL; 281 NEW_WORK_MANDATE belongs
  to AGREEMENT. Their subject matter does not admit them into the crown group.
  344 MONARCH_ARRIVAL, 345 HASTY_MONARCH and 346 SATISFIED_MONARCH also map
  to GENERAL, despite describing a ruler. Their active reference producers
  are e4a320/submit e4b674, e46c20/submit e46ef2, and e39910/submit e3b9a5.

  The actual complete Fortress renderer is retained in
  fortress-rectangle/pe-reference-placement-renderer-owner.c and its classic
  counterpart. The icon hover selects alert pointer at 3f6351, reads alert+8
  report IDs, resolves complete stored report.text, and only then wraps it.
  Missing IDs contribute nothing. repeat_count>0 appends " x" and decimal
  int32(repeat_count+1); otherwise the text is unchanged. Native colors and
  brightness are retained per wrapped row. The fixed whole instruction is
    Left click for recenter and expand options.  Right click to dismiss.
  The selected-alert popup is announcement-popup-native/renderer/
  reference-40d5f0.c (classic-40b1b0.c). It uses the same complete stored
  records and repeat suffix. Its two whole instruction branches are already
  retained in ui-messages.tsv. There is no separate noble sentence template
  in either renderer, and a physical wrapped row is not a new production.

NOBLE_ARRIVAL (68)
  The category mapper admits 68. The paired complete native submission graph
  contains no active type-68 writer. Modern monarch arrival has the distinct
  type 344 described above. A new native sentence is not inferred from the
  legacy enum's name; external/custom producers remain an open input.

DIPLOMAT_ARRIVAL (79)
  Fresh actual C: reference-diplomat-arrival.c (e4b750..e4ca6c), paired
  classic-diplomat-arrival.c (e466c0..e479dc); reference submit e4c97e.
  The complete source is "A " + creature_raw.name[2] + " diplomat from "
    + a94030(entity.name) + " has arrived."
  Invalid race/empty adjective leaves an empty RAW adjective; absent name
  leaves an empty entity field. Both fields are appended independently, so
  the four empty/nonempty combinations are explicit whole productions.
  The RAW adjective is not a person or office. The new runtime binding is
  $embark-race-adjective, shared with the same RAW field in embark captions.

LIAISON_ARRIVAL (80)
  Fresh actual C: reference-producer-e4ca70.c and classic-producer-e479e0.c;
  reference submissions e4db33/e4dc87.
  Normal: complete 1331500 unit reference + " from " + a94030(entity.name)
    + " has arrived."
  The unit and entity formatters can both finish empty and the producer has
  no nonempty guard; the four combinations are separate complete sources.
  Missing liaison: "No " + position.name(+98) + "? How curious..."
  The neutral position name can be empty: "No ? How curious..." remains a
  real completed source. No alternate gendered title is selected here.
  $unit, $memory-entity and $office preserve these independent native fields.

TRADE_DIPLOMAT_ARRIVAL (81)
  Fresh actual C: reference-trade-diplomat-arrival.c (e4dd10..e4f038) and
  classic-trade-diplomat-arrival.c (e48c80..e49fa8); reference submit e4eec8.
  The complete source is literal "A " + 132f980(unit,true) + " from "
    + a94030(entity.name) + " has arrived."
  The role is not a full named actor and need not contain a species prefix:
  a RAW office such as high treasurer is a complete role by itself. The
  literal article precedes it unconditionally. Role and entity can each be
  empty, yielding four complete productions. The typed role supplier also
  admits animation corpse/body-part names, RAW caste/profession and gendered
  or spouse offices, territory, custom profession, slavery/prisoner, training,
  ghost and curse wrappers. Its full branches and 135-case occupation word
  supplier are retained in this directory's C/ASM and native-switches.tsv.
  The actor/office/name distinction comes from this producer, not spelling.

FORT_POSITION_SUCCESSION (178)
  Actual paired C and matching ASM:
    announcement-profession-succession/{reference,classic}-producer-9ba3c0.c
      (classic function is 9b7bf0; reference submits 9ba97b/9bc954)
    announcement-profession-succession/reference-producer-14644c0.c
      (classic 145f430; reference submit 1464a5a)
    announcement-profession-succession/reference-producer-1468370.c
      (classic 14632e0; reference submits 1477308/1477895/1477e50)
  The names of classic per-function files use the actual classic RVA.

  Complete forms (P is 1330260(unit,true), O is the position field below):
    P + " has assumed the position of " + O + "."
    P + " has claimed the position of " + O + "."
    "After a polite discussion with a local rival, " + P
      + " has claimed the position of " + O + "."
    "After a polite discussion with local rivals, " + P
      + " has claimed the position of " + O + "."
    P + ", being the rightful heir, has inherited the position of " + O + "."
    P + " has been appointed to the position of " + O + "."
    P + " has been elected to the position of " + O + "."

  The claim constructor counts eligible local contenders. Count<=1 omits
  the entire introduction (1464813..1464847); count==2 selects a local rival;
  count>2 selects local rivals. The no-introduction branch was missing from
  the old world-message catalog. The other branches in these large owners
  change historical state or produce other announcement types; they do not
  contribute extra NOBLE text merely by sharing a function.

  RAW office selection uses neutral position.name(+98), female(+d8) or
  male(+118), falling back to neutral when a gendered field is empty.
  1468370 calls the same gendered selection through 99a3c0. Neutral is
  appended without a nonempty guard. For land_holder>0, 9bdfb0 looks for a
  matching land/assignment and appends " of " then a946e0 English site name.
  Missing land/assignment returns false. These succession producers append
  " of " plus b92900 entity caption if land_holder<=0 or that lookup fails.
  The site and entity formatters have no nonempty guard after " of ".
  Thus a complete O may contain a title and owner, title with empty owner,
  empty title with owner, or both fields empty leaving the separator.
  The new noble-position grammar preserves these independently typed fields.
  It never treats the office, territory, or complete sentence as a person.

  The fresh fortress-nobles/{reference,classic}-personal-name.c extraction
  proves that P is not always a personal name. A missing, hidden or empty
  name falls back to 132f980(unit,true), including RAW creature/profession,
  custom profession and status/animation branches. Therefore the runtime
  actor uses $unit, not $person. Named actors use a946e0 EnglishName with
  its nickname/word components. The separate selected office after the
  predicate remains $office and never inherits the actor's authored label.

ELECTION_RESULTS (266)
  announcement-profession-succession/reference-producer-e646f0.c,
  classic-producer-e5f660.c; reference whole submit e65724.
  The actor is the complete 1330c30(unit,false) identity, which may already
  contain a profession, office and territory. The actor and new position are
  independent fields; neither is a bare arbitrary wildcard.
  Matching previous holder: actor + " has been re-elected."
  Otherwise: actor + " has been elected " + gendered position.name +
    optional(9bdfb0 land suffix when land_holder>0) + "."
  There is no entity fallback for failed territory lookup in this producer.
  The unchecked neutral title may be empty; an empty title without a suffix
  leaves the literal " has been elected ." and is handled as a whole source.
  A failed election or disabled announcement emits no alternative text.

LAND_GAINS_STATUS (254), LAND_ELEVATED_STATUS (255)
  Actual PE C: adventure-popup-pe/pe-producer-ac5b30.c, complete owner
  ac5b30..ac7561; reference submits ac6b5c (254) and ac7408 (255).
  The shared complete production is a94030 NativeName(site) +
    " and the surrounding lands have been made " + LAND + "."
  Subtype 3 fallback: "an official land of the realm".
  Subtype 4 fallback: "an even more official land of the realm".
  Nonempty position.land_name can replace the fallback; ordinary installed
  RAW values are a barony/a county/a duchy. Empty LAND_NAME keeps the native
  fallback. Missing site or disabled announcement returns without a record.
  NativeName(site) can be empty; no English-name substitution occurs here.
  The existing announcement-status-grammar.tsv contains all five vanilla
  whole forms, all five empty-site forms, and typed non-vanilla LAND_NAME
  forms. The earlier ELF extraction in fortress-land-elevation/ independently
  retains the equivalent supplier bodies and RAW values. The PE C confirms
  the same sources for the currently configured Windows images.

Mandate and demand types
  Actual PE C: adventure-popup-pe/pe-producer-{e39910,134ac10,134de20,
  13b2a30}.c. Both editions' complete ASM, branches, literals and exact owner
  extents are in fortress-announcement-mandates/.
  Every actor below is the whole 1330c30(unit,false) identity:
    273 actor + " has forgotten a demand."
        134ac10, submit 134ad96
    274 actor + " has a new demand."
        134ac10, submit 134b95b
    275 actor + " has mandated the construction of certain goods."
        134de20 mode 1, submit 134e7f8
    275 actor + " has imposed a ban on certain exports."
        134de20 mode 0, same submit
    276 actor + " has altered the prices of goods."
        134de20, submit 134ea38
    263 actor + " has ended a mandate."
        e39910 existing unit, submit e3c79c
    263 "A mandate has ended."
        e39910 missing unit, submit e3c811
    263 actor + "'s mandate has ended."
        13b2a30 matching count 1, submit 13b2bb7
    263 actor + "'s mandates have ended."
        13b2a30 matching count >1, same submit
  134de20 sets mandate mode from a boolean comparison, so the apparent
  neither-0-nor-1 suffix fallthrough cannot emit a third construction.
  13b2a30 count zero returns before submission. Thought labels such as
  "mandate was obeyed" belong to a different formatter, not this category's
  announcement constructors. The nine complete productions already use $unit.
  The fresh unit-caption.c shows that 1330c30 can still produce an empty
  identity: no visible name, empty neutral RAW role from 132f980, no status/
  training wrapper. Its third argument at the report sites is false, but the
  inner role call enables custom profession with true. There is no nonempty
  guard before appending any of these predicates. The eight actor-bearing
  empty forms, including the bare possessive "'s mandate(s)", are now explicit
  whole productions in announcement-mandate-grammar.tsv and translations.tsv.

GUILD_WAGES_CHANGED (280)
  Both native mapping tables admit this enum into NOBLE. The complete paired
  direct-submission graph in announcement-popup-native/native-submission-
  types.tsv contains no active type-280 writer (including alternative reaching
  descriptor values). No authored wage-change sentence was recovered from
  these images. This records the dormant admitted enum, not an invented
  report template. External/custom announcement producers can supply arbitrary
  text and are not finite native branches inferred from this enum name.

Runtime maintenance
  The new succession/election entries are in announcement-status-grammar.tsv
  and are directly mirrored as Announcement combat entries in translations.tsv.
  No data generator, compilation, game input, module inspection, runtime log,
  or simulated display check is part of this source work.
